segments.speaker: LISA
segments.en: Hi Tony, thanks ever so much for coming. You know we've been asked to organise something for John's farewell?

segments.speaker: TONY
segments.en: Yeah, sure, it's about time we started working out details.

segments.speaker: LISA
segments.en: Exactly. We don't want to leave it so late that it's double the work.

segments.speaker: TONY
segments.en: Mmm, mm, right, do you want me to take notes?

segments.speaker: LISA
segments.en: That'd be great, thanks.

segments.speaker: TONY
segments.en: Right, first thing is, when is the best time to hold it?

segments.speaker: LISA
segments.en: Well, he leaves on the twenty-fourth of December.

segments.speaker: TONY
segments.en: So what about the twenty-second?

segments.speaker: LISA
segments.en: Yeah, I think that's about right. We want it quite near the time, don't we?

segments.speaker: TONY
segments.en: Sure. and what about a venue? In co!Jege? A hotel?

segments.speaker: LISA
segments.en: I think a hotel will probably work out rather expensive, and I've been looking at the College Dining Room; that seems pretty reasonable.

segments.speaker: TONY
segments.en: Fine, yeah, why not?

segments.speaker: LISA
segments.en: And then we ought to be thinking about invitations . .. Who mustn't we forget to invite?

segments.speaker: TONY
segments.en: Well, obviously John and his wife.

segments.speaker: LISA
segments.en: Right.

segments.speaker: TONY
segments.en: And the Director.

segments.speaker: LISA
segments.en: Ahha.

segments.speaker: TONY
segments.en: The office staff.

segments.speaker: LISA
segments.en: Yep, and all the teachers and all the students.

segments.speaker: TONY
segments.en: Anyone else?

segments.speaker: LIS A
segments.en: Faculty Heads?

segments.speaker: TONY
segments.en: No, better draw the line, I don't think it's necessary.

segments.speaker: LISA
segments.en: Yeah, you're right.

segments.speaker: TONY
segments.en: I don't mind writing the invitations. When shall we get them out for?

segments.speaker: LISA
segments.en: Enough time but not too early. What about the fifteenth of December?

segments.speaker: TONY
segments.en: Well, there are exams on the sixteenth - better avoid them.

segments.speaker: LISA
segments.en: Tenth?

segments.speaker: TONY
segments.en: Yeah, that should do it.

segments.speaker: LISA
segments.en: So what does that leave? Oh yes, a present.

segments.speaker: TONY
segments.en: Would you mind doing that?

segments.speaker: LISA
segments.en: No, not at all; we usually go round with an envelope during coffee break, don't we?

segments.speaker: TONY
segments.en: Yeah, coffee break's always the best time, 'cos people have got their money handy.

segments.speaker: LISA
segments.en: Yeah, exactly. Do we suggest an amount? Or does it seem a bit unfair?

segments.speaker: TONY
segments.en: No, I think people welcome it. We suggested~ dollars last time, is that OK?

segments.speaker: LISA
segments.en: Yeah, plenty I would have thought, which should leave us with about ninety dollars.

segments.speaker: TONY
segments.en: Have you any ideas for presents?

segments.speaker: LISA
segments.en: Well, I've been having a little think. I thought, you know, he loves music.

segments.speaker: TONY
segments.en: Yeah, and books.

segments.speaker: LIS A
segments.en: So, I thought I'd check on prices for, well, perhaps CD players.

segments.speaker: TONY
segments.en: Yeah, that's a, that's a good idea, and also I thought maybe. you know. a~ dictionaries. I heard him say he needed a good one.

segments.speaker: LISA
segments.en: The other thing he was saying last week was that his computer printer had broken.

segments.speaker: TONY
segments.en: Umm. No, I'd be really frightened about getting the wrong type.

segments.speaker: LISA
segments.en: OK, yeah.

segments.speaker: TONY
segments.en: The other thing is something for the home - Jill suggested a coffee maker.

segments.speaker: LISA
segments.en: Oh yeah. I'll certainly find out what they cost. OK. have you got all that down?

segments.speaker: TONY
segments.en: Yes.

segments.speaker: LISA
segments.en: Now we need to think a little more about the money. I know we've got a set amount from the Social Fund.

segments.speaker: TONY
segments.en: Right, what does that cover?

segments.speaker: LISA
segments.en: It's meant to cover the cost of the room.

segments.speaker: TONY
segments.en: Yeah.

segments.speaker: LISA
segments.en: And a certain amount for food.

segments.speaker: TONY
segments.en: And also drinks?

segments.speaker: LISA
segments.en: Oh yeah, certainly.

segments.speaker: TONY
segments.en: But will it be enough?

segments.speaker: LISA
segments.en: What we've done in the past is to ask guests to bring some snacks.

segments.speaker: TONY
segments.en: Right.

segments.speaker: LISA
segments.en: We don't ask them to bring more drinks because we figure that's ... that should come from the Social Fund.

segments.speaker: TONY
segments.en: OK. Anything else for the guests to bring?

segments.speaker: LISA
segments.en: Well, some music, because there'll be a tape deck there in the room, and we can have some dancing later on.

segments.speaker: TONY
segments.en: Anything else?

segments.speaker: LISA
segments.en: Well, it's just a thought, but a couple of years ago we had a really good party where we set up, you know, some simple games.

segments.speaker: TONY
segments.en: Yeah, great. Wasn't it based on photos from the students and teachers?

segments.speaker: LISA
segments.en: That's right.

segments.speaker: TONY
segments.en: So we should ask the guests to bring~· OK. I'll put it on the invitations.

segments.speaker: LISA
segments.en: Now the last thing is, who shall we ask to do the~?

segments.speaker: TONY
segments.en: · Don't you think it might be nice to have one of the students?

segments.speaker: LISA
segments.en: Well then, the Student Leader?

segments.speaker: TONY
segments.en: Yeah, much better than the Director giving speeches again.

segments.speaker: LISA
segments.en: OK then, I'll ask her. Lovely! So, is that all?

segments.speaker: TONY
segments.en: Looks like it.

segments.speaker: LISA
segments.en: Great. Thanks ever so much .. . (fade our)
